biography.plain_text: Alisher Usmanov is an Uzbekistan-born Russian industrial investor who made his first fortune producing scarce plastic bags in the late Soviet period. He later built his core wealth through a series of acquisitions in iron ore and steel, assembled as Metalloinvest, before grouping mining, telecommunications and technology interests under USM. Early investments in Facebook and other technology companies broadened the portfolio, while fencing administration and cultural philanthropy became prominent later chapters.
